title: Rail Analytics stat catalogue
description: The statistics the Analytics screen checks against a target (docs/ANALYTICS.md Step 1). A rate stat is a counter in the decision-event language of docs/STATS-SPEC.md section 14: the same text counts the hero and every opponent (rail_stats::custom::CustomSet) and names the decisions whose analysed reference gives the target. A share stat is the share of another stat's actions made with weak hand classes (hero only: it needs the cards). A coded stat is a shipped statistic of standard.json, shown with no target. Read by the app (core/rail-stats/src/analytics.rs) and the web (web/src/lib/stats/analytics.ts, a copy of this file). What a schema cannot check - the predicate grammar, that a rate's action is exactly its class, unique ids, references between entries - core/rail-stats checks at load and in CI.

version.description: Version of this file's shape. A file of another version is refused.

actionClasses.description: Which of a decision's five actions each class takes: a decision's chosen action is in the class, and the target sums the reference frequencies of the options in it.

handClasses.description: The hand classes of a postflop decision, strongest first, from the analysis facts (facts.made.class and facts.draws). The first class whose conditions hold is the hand's; the last has none and takes the rest.

sizeBuckets.description: The bet-size buckets of a decision that faces a bet after the flop (docs/ANALYTICS.md section 3), smallest first. A bet of facts.facingPot (a fraction of the pot before it) falls in the last bucket whose min it reaches, min in thousandths of the pot and the size rounded to them. The first starts at 0, so a bet under 20% of the pot counts with 20-40%. Stored with each checker row (Step 2).

groups.description: The blocks of the Streets tab and the headings of All stats, in display order.

families.description: Which stats a finding merges (Overview): ids only, their headlines live in packages/ui/strings/analytics.*.ts.

min.description: Where the bucket starts, in thousandths of the pot (400 = 40%).

made.description: The hand's made class is one of these (web/src/lib/analysis/types.ts MadeHandClass).

draws.description: The hand has at least one of these draws (DrawClass).

words.description: The gap in words: high when the player's number is above the target band, low when below. Never a colour (packages/ui/README.md rule 7).

id.description: Stable identifier: routes (/stats/<id>), stored rows and the Trainer link refer to it. At most 57 bytes: its custom counter is an_<id>.

group.description: A groups id of the same street.

min.description: Opportunities (for a share: the parent's actions) below which the stat is grey, "Not sure yet", whatever its gap.

floor.description: The band's smallest half-width in percentage points: target +- max(floor, 1.96 * sqrt(t(1-t)/n)).

oneOf.description: A rate: made / opportunities of its predicate.

count.description: A counter in the decision-event language (docs/STATS-SPEC.md 14.2): mode, opportunity => action. The action must be exactly a test of `action` against the class's actions.

coded.description: A shipped statistic (standard.json) the count must equal on every corpus row: its formula is pct(made, opportunities).

within.description: A rate of the same street and class whose opportunities include every one of this stat's: a finding does not add its cost twice.

oneOf.description: A share: of the actions of the rate `of`, the share made with a hand class in `weak` (hero only).
A shipped statistic of standard.json, with no target.
